purpose: **THE D-7 EXCEPTION.** The application's own storage credential is refused by the store, and StoragePermissionDeniedError emits `permission_denied` -- the catalog code whose summary describes an *authenticated subject*. There is no subject in this scenario at all. R-3 settles it at the reseal by giving the storage case a code of its own, so this record's bytes change on purpose
pre_authorization: Captured before the T-6 reseal. Every request here is unauthenticated and is answered. This is not a post-auth expectation.

exception.ruling: OWNER_RULINGS_2026-09-17.md R-3 -- tokens *and* the storage code
exception.permitted_change: StoragePermissionDeniedError currently emits `permission_denied` with the catalog's authenticated-subject message. The reseal moves it to a code of its own, so this record's status, error_code, message and details may all change. The commit that decides it is cited beside the new expectation.
exception.everything_else: Every other difference in this directory is a failure of the wave, whatever argument accompanies it.

body.text: {"contract_version": "1.0.0-draft.1", "error_code": "permission_denied", "message": "The authenticated subject is not permitted to perform this operation on this resource. Authorization is decided server-side.", "correlation_id": "{{correlation_id}}", "retryable": false, "details": {"required_capability": "blob_storage_rw", "aggregate_type": "Blob"}}

tokens.{{content_length}}: a function of the body, which is compared byte for byte; the comparison asserts Content-Length == str(len(body)) separately
tokens.{{correlation_id}}: assigned by the edge because the request carried none; checked against the pinned CorrelationId shape before being tokenised
tokens.{{session_tag}}: this capture run's tag, carried by every idempotency key
